title: Syllabus
description: A graded list of classical guitar pieces from a recognized examining board, used as labelled training data for the difficulty grading model (spec Milestone 2).

syllabus.description: Short identifier for the examining board.

edition.description: Edition label as published by the board (e.g. '2018', '2020-2023').

extracted_on.description: ISO date the piece list was extracted from source.

grades.description: Ordered list of grade labels used by this syllabus (e.g. ['Initial','1','2',...,'8']).

grade.description: Must match one of the labels in the parent `grades` array.

list.description: Some syllabi split each grade into multiple lists (A/B/C). Optional.

imslp_url.description: Optional link to the IMSLP page if known at extraction time.
